location: g:IMO_040_ShipShape true applicability branch / nltl:hasRelevantHatchOrDoor property shape
problem: When nltl:iceAccretionLikely is true, nltl:hasRelevantHatchOrDoor has no sh:minCount, so the condition can validate a ship with no represented hatch-or-door inventory and therefore no associated ice or snow removal or prevention means.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasRelevantHatchOrDoor property shape in the true applicability branch.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional behavior: require the hatch-or-door inventory and per-item means only when nltl:iceAccretionLikely is true; do not require them in the false branch.
